title: Two Overlooked Skills Predict Children's Reading Success
paragraphs: Some children find reading hard. Why? Scientists wanted to know.
A team at Texas A&M University looked at many old studies. They used data from 137 reading tests.
Two skills were very important. One skill is hearing the sounds in words. The other skill is knowing many words. Being clever was less important than people thought.
